newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Tallinn stock market changes TALSE index method.
newsitem.headline: Tallinn stock market changes TALSE index method.

text.p: The Tallinn Stock Exchange said on Thursday its board had decided to change the calculation method of the exchange's TALSE index as from February 17.
The new method will bring the market into line with global practice based on closing prices as opposed to the existing method calculating the weighted average prices of transactions.

"Now that the market has higher volumes and good liquidity, the board decided that is no need to use the weighted average price system," Helo Meigas, managing director of the Stock Exchange told Reuters on Thursday.
"The average price system was initially used because if the market was a bit thin then the closing prices would not accurately reflect the market trends," she added.

The Tallinn Stock exchange started operations in May 1995 but has already eclipsed the markets in the other two Baltic countries of Latvia and Lithuania and is viewed as the strongest bourse in the region.
